comment: Bundled seed index: the packages that are real today (see packages/README.md). Served by SkillRegistryClient when no registry is reachable, and preloaded by `apyrobo registry start --seed`. VCS installs carry no artifact checksum, so checksum is empty for these entries.

packages.name: apyrobo-skills-ros-nav
packages.description: Real ROS 2 Nav2 skills — navigate_to_pose and friends call the live NavigateToPose action via rclpy. Part of the flagship reference stack, exercised against a physics TurtleBot3 in Gazebo by CI.
packages.author: APYROBO Contributors

packages.name: apyrobo-client-ts
packages.description: Zero-dependency TypeScript client for the wire protocol (spec/wire-protocol.md) — plans and executes tasks through `apyrobo serve` over stdio or WebSocket. CI runs it against the Python reference server on every commit.
packages.author: APYROBO Contributors
